faqs.question: Will this butter leave my skin sticky?
faqs.answer: This is lightweight formula. Though it will provide your skin with deep moisturization, it will absorb quickly.

faqs.question: Can I use this twice a day?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use as needed. Post application in morning, follow up with a sunscreen

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months.

faqs.question: What is so special about this product?
faqs.answer: It works well specially for people who have dry skin as reapplication of moisturiser is not required if they use this cream.

faqs.question: Is this product only for dry skin?
faqs.answer: This products works well for all skin types. We recommend doing a patch test.
